summary: I tested the detention billing packet and finalization feature end to end over the public URL as the Clerk QA user in fleet 'TEST_QA Haulers'. New pytest file test_billing_packet_http.py: 13/13 passed. The existing test_finalization.py still passes 8/8. Main flow works: the pickup invoice is $75, ready, while transport is in_progress. Right after the final departure ping, the load is completed, the packet is draft v1, submission is blocked, total is 187.5, and there is a POD blocker. The driver payload has transport_completed and documents_needed. In the UI: uploading the POD changes the blocker to 'signature not yet confirmed'; 'I checked: signed' clears it and submission becomes 'awaiting_review'; Approve & submit gives 'Accepted (simulated)', 'Issued v1', both invoices sent, and the PDF opens. Also verified: idempotency (still 2 invoices, 1 submission, 1 packet after repeat pings and reloads), per-load cap (150 = 75 + 75), portal flow (awaiting_portal, invoices stay ready, recorded through portal-ref-input and portal-done-button), unknown terms (terms_missing blocker with an action, no invoice), manual completion (reason shown), the Edit terms Billing & submission section (term-source badges, 'Unknown / not stated' selects, save works), demo fleet states (all 5 as expected), security, and regression pages (invoices page, /e/<token>, driver email card). The 5-page PDF looks professional. I found 2 real bugs: the revision flow can submit a packet with no new charges, and the old per-invoice Send on the Invoices page skips the packet blockers.

critical.issue: Skips the new packet flow. On a load whose submission was 'blocked' (POD missing, destination not confirmed, review mode), Send returned 200 and marked DC-1021 'sent' to the broker contact email (delivered@resend.dev) instead of the AP email (ap@example.test). No packet was issued and no outbox job was created. In live mode this would bill without the required documents and bypass dispatcher review. Repro: load with blockers -> POST /api/invoices/{ready_inv}/send -> 200, invoice sent, completion.submission is still 'blocked'.

Revision submits a packet with no new charges. After a dispatcher adjusts times on an already-submitted load (delivery departure +30 min), detention goes from 187.5 to 225. Invoice DC-1018 stays 'sent' 112.5 with pending_adjustment +37.5. Submission becomes 'revision_review' and the button reads 'Issue revision & submit new charges'. Submitting issues v2 and sends a second (simulated) billing email whose packet lists only 'Previously submitted' invoices: invoiced 187.5 while detention_calculated is 225. The supplemental invoice (DC-1018-A1) is only created after a separate manual 'Issue correction', which then needs a v3 packet and a third email. POST /invoices/{id}/adjust also does not rerun finalize, so v3 only appears after the next page load or cron.

minor.issue: The destination comparison treats '' and None as different. A PUT where billing_company or portal_url goes from None to '' (for example, typing in a field and then clearing it) drops billing_setup.confirmed_at and adds a 'destination_unconfirmed' blocker even though nothing changed. Normalize empty strings before comparing.
The submission state keeps the old 'simulated' flag, so the UI chip reads 'Revision awaiting review (simulated)' before anything has been submitted.
Deleting a load with draft packets leaves orphan packets (6 found in the QA fleet). This may be intended under keep_forever, but draft packets of deleted loads are just noise.

When offline pings arrive late, broker notices are sent hours after the stop. The payor-facing packet then shows 'Detention notice: Sent LATE' under exceptions. This is accurate but works against the carrier; consider not auto-sending notices for stops that have already departed.

integration_issues.issue: The Send button on ready invoices skips the packet, review and blocker workflow (see the backend critical item). Hide it, or route it through /billing/submit, for loads that use packet billing.

issues: Raw event type 'document_uploaded' and raw value "pod" are shown instead of readable labels.
The unverified-documents list shows 'signature not confirmed' for every unverified doc type, including lumper receipts and other non-signature documents.
Portal ref input and reconcile ref input share the same state (f.ref).
Manual completion and approval datetime-local inputs use the browser's timezone, not the fleet timezone.

action_items: Make POST /invoices/{id}/send respect packet blockers, billing mode and the AP destination (or hide Send for packet-billed loads).

Revision flow: when a sent invoice has a pending_adjustment, either create the supplement or credit invoice automatically before the revision is issued, or block 'Issue revision & submit' until the correction exists. Rerun finalize after /invoices/{id}/adjust.
Normalize ''/None in the destination comparison so a no-op edit does not drop the billing confirmation.
Reset the 'simulated' flag when submission moves to revision_review.
Minor UI polish: readable labels for timeline document events; only show 'signature not confirmed' for signed_bol and pod documents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2330 lines and finalize.py is 817; split them into routers and modules.

mark_portal_submitted calls enqueue with an idempotency key per packet; if the job already exists (accepted), it is set back to 'sending' and accepted again. The endpoint guard on the awaiting_portal state prevents this today, but the service function itself is not idempotent.
required_documents for a 'pod' requirement accepts bol_photo/signed_bol/pod types interchangeably; this is intentional but may be looser than what the payor requires.

success_rate.backend: 13/13 new HTTP tests + 8/8 in-process tests pass; 2 high-severity logic bugs found by exploratory checks
success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested UI flows work; 1 integration gap on the Invoices page)

seed_data_creation: QA fleet: several TEST-* loads (MAIN, PORTAL, UIA, UIP, UIM, CAP, etc.). Loads with sent invoices cannot be deleted (by design) and remain; the others were deleted. The demo fleet was not modified (read-only DB checks only). The fleet billing profile legal_name/remittance_address is set.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest -v -n 0 tests/test_billing_packet_http.py. pytest.ini adds -n/xdist with loadscope; use -n 0 for order-dependent classes. UI loads: python /app/tests/mk_billing_ui_loads.py prints ids. To render PDFs, pip install --target /tmp/pdfium pypdfium2. The server clock reads Oct 2026. Re-test: the revision flow (billing_revision_check.py) and the legacy invoice Send bypass (/tmp/legacy.py logic: send a ready invoice on a blocked load).
rca of the issue: Legacy Send: /invoices/{id}/send predates finalize and only checks invoice status and broker email, then calls finalize_load afterwards instead of gating on completion.blockers or billing_setup. Revision: upsert_draft detects a material change and sets revision_review, but ensure_invoices only records pending_adjustment on sent invoices and never creates the supplement row. The snapshot therefore has no new invoice rows, yet submit_packet still issues and emails the new version.
